offering_description.value: Provides technology and administrative services to Grand Canyon University and other colleges and universities. It also helps partner institutions deliver hybrid nursing and allied health programs through online coursework and in-person skills labs.

primary_services.value: Learning technology and support; student recruitment and enrollment support; student counseling and administrative support; curriculum development; hybrid healthcare program operations

customer_segment.value: B2B: Colleges and universities, including institutions with nursing and allied health programs

end_markets.value: Higher education; nursing and allied health education

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Long-term university agreements for program and administrative services, with fees generally tied to tuition and related fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Combines university program requirements with its own technology and staff to deliver outsourced services to partner institutions

geography_served.value: US national: United States, with nationwide online delivery and in-person education sites across multiple states

specialization.value: related lines: Higher education technology, enrollment and administrative support, and hybrid healthcare education operations

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Service agreements negotiated directly with colleges and universities; online: Learning platforms and remote support for partner institutions and their students; own locations: Company-operated sites for partner programs’ in-person labs and simulations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: U.S. Department of Education rules for third-party servicing of federal student aid and FERPA student-record privacy requirements
